column4: Any of the five Kinetix axes reporting a non-zero AxisFault word. Fault source for Seq_Status = 3.
A sequencer MAJ was rejected (.ER). Clears when the sequencer re-issues the jog on the next cycle.
A sequencer MAS was rejected (.ER). Clears when the sequencer re-issues the stop on the next cycle.
A sequencer MSO was rejected (.ER). Clears when the sequencer re-issues the servo-on at step 1.
Any motion command the auto sequencer issues came back errored. Fault source for Seq_Status = 3.
HMI status pill. 0 STOPPED, 1 RUNNING, 2 HOLDING, 3 FAULTED. Written only by HMI_Status.
